prov-kamu-kamu.text: Little by little makes a bundle.
alts: one by one makes a bundle
bit by bit makes a bundle
he who goes slowly goes far
the teeth that are together bite the meat

prov-olugalo-olumu.text: One finger can’t kill a louse.
alts: one finger does not kill a louse

prov-atannayitaayita.text: Who hasn’t travelled thinks mother cooks best.
alts: he who has not travelled praises his mother’s cooking
What is the meaning of this proverb?

s36-amakulu.text: I want to know the meaning.
alts: I would like to know the meaning.
It means that unity is strength.

s36-kamu-kamu.text: As they say, little by little makes a bundle.
alts: As the saying goes, little by little makes a bundle.

s36-akwata-mpola.text: Don’t worry. Slow and steady goes far.
alts: Don’t be afraid. Slow and steady goes far.

s36-agali-awamu.text: Let’s work together! Teeth together bite the meat.
alts: Let’s work together! Unity is strength.

s36-olugalo-olumu.text: Help me. One finger can’t kill a louse.
alts: Help me. One finger does not kill a louse.

jjajjas-advice.title: Jjajja’s advice
jjajjas-advice.summary: Ssali is impatient with his new business, and Jjajja answers with proverbs.
lines: Grandma, my business isn’t doing well. There are few customers.
Don’t worry, my child. Slow and steady goes far.
It means: be patient. Little by little makes a bundle.
But I work alone. I’m tired.
One finger can’t kill a louse! Work with Nakato.
Good idea. Teeth together bite the meat!
Haha! Now you speak like a grandparent!

questions.question: Which proverb tells Ssali to work with others?
options: One finger can’t kill a louse.
Little by little makes a bundle.
